g.title: U1
g.text: PWM only on D6 and D11: the Servo library
takes Timer1, so D9 and D10 have no PWM.
Pins are inputs during reset, so R2 holds

g.title: R2
g.text: Holds all four enable inputs low

g.title: R4_R9
g.text: One 10 kOhm resistor from each driver input to GND.
They hold the inputs low if the USB cable comes loose.

g.title: U2
g.text: TI SLRS008D. VCC1 4.5-7 V, VCC2 from VCC1 to 36 V:
Inputs: VIH min 2.3 V, driven at 5 V by the Leonardo.
600 mA per channel. Pins 4, 5, 12, 13: ground and heat sink.
Bypass: C1 at VCC1, C2 at VCC2 (section 10).

g.title: RAIL_5V_SERVO
g.text: 5.2 V from the BEC12S-PRO, after the
and track motor supply (U2 VCC2, D021)

g.title: U3
g.text: Channels 3 and 4 unused: 3,4EN, 3A and 4A tied to GND,
Bypass: C3 at VCC1, C4 at VCC2 (section 10).

g.title: J4
g.text: Swap the leads if the track runs backward.

g.title: J5
g.text: Swap the leads if the track runs backward.

g.title: J6
g.text: Datasheet Rev D. Pot 5 kOhm +-50%, wiper between the
two references: GND and +5V_USB (PQ12: any stable
reference voltages, D020). Stall 210 mA at 12 V.
Max duty cycle 20%. Swap pins 2/3 to reverse.
